description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Physical Mutation

A large, aggressive worm takes up residence in your belly. Whether it’s a parasite or some part of your biology that’s taken a life of its own is unknown. What you do know is that it’s always hungry, hence so are you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.xneBqGOs1QS7kfUr]{Hungry} Creature Trait. You may spend 1 Advantage to have the worm make a free attack on someone that you’ve engaged in melee - it launches itself from a hole in your stomach. The worm deals your SB+1 Damage if you succeed with a Ballistic Skill Test. The attack may be blocked by a shield, just like a projectile. You can only gain this mutation once.
